projects.name: plastron
projects.tagline: A polyglot reactive substrate. Cels hold values, formulas, or compiled lambdas in each language that has an installed compiler. Live at plastron.ca.

projects.name: SQLite Studio
projects.tagline: A database GUI in one self-contained index.html. It runs demand-paged SQLite with its pages in IndexedDB, and it has a schema tree, a SQL editor, CSV export, and CRUD. It runs from file://.

projects.name: RheoServ Waumpaum
projects.tagline: An offline-first credit-union core in one encrypted HTML file. cr-sqlite merges the work of the operators, and waumpaums settle between institutions.

projects.name: Offline Protected-B HRIS
projects.tagline: A Protected-B HRIS that runs offline in one HTML file. CRDT SQLite merges the HR records of the operators.

projects.name: The Colonial Advocate
projects.tagline: A single-page web app. Its model is the 19th-century reform newspaper of William Lyon Mackenzie.

projects.name: Firearms vs Homicide
projects.tagline: A chart of civilian firearm ownership (Small Arms Survey 2017) and intentional homicide rates (UNODC) for each country.

projects.name: genenote-js
projects.tagline: A JavaScript implementation of Lion Kimbra's genenote that runs on plastron.
